_comment_subs: draw_bar is a constant-time fn: loop1 (width iters) + loop2 (bar_max-width iters) = bar_max total, so its cost is data-dependent (author assumes bar_max=40 -> 674c inc JSR). The walker can't resolve this statically, so we pin it here to the author's figure. draw_row inlines correctly once draw_bar is pinned.
_comment_vertical: vblinds is a fixed-duration buffer-fill effect (linear_to_screen_loop over the 160-byte buffer + 14 constant-time draw_bar calls + a .here timing loop), NOT a single per-scanline rupture loop. The vertical model can only multiply ONE loop by its trip count, so it would undercount the total and report a bogus pass. Vertical analysis is disabled (null); only horizontal per-line cycle costs + running totals are annotated.
